verdict.rationale: Azure RBAC provides fine-grained access management to resources, with per-principal scoping such as letting one identity manage only VMs and another only networks. Applications can be registered with Microsoft Entra ID to secure REST requests, and managed identities let workloads obtain Entra tokens without handling any credentials. Together these give a credible path to issuing least-privilege credentials to an agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of issuing scoped service-principal or app credentials (secret/certificate lifetime, scope assignment), any agent-specific identity guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
